projects.title: Novana
projects.description: Founded Novana, an AI-powered PMOS symptom tracking platform built full-stack with Next.js 14, Supabase, and GPT-4, featuring a real-time analytics engine, cycle phase-aware AI insights with medical safety guardrails, and automated doctor-report generation, after spending years developing AI models to study PMOS symptom patterns following my own diagnosis at 14. The platform transforms daily logs across 8 biomarkers into personalized pattern insights and actionable health summaries, with row-level encrypted data storage, a Resend-powered notification system, and a Capacitor-based iOS app in active development for App Store submission targeting Fall 2026.

projects.title: UPWARDS Semiconductor Fabrication Project — Hiroshima University
projects.description: Hands-on design and fabrication of CMOS, PMOS, and NMOS chip structures through Hiroshima University, completed as part of a competitive summer research internship at Hiroshima University's RISE facility.

projects.title: ReVal — Career Fair Intelligence Platform React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Firebase, Playwright, BeautifulSoup
projects.description: A real-time career fair intelligence platform that generates resume-to-role talking points, recruiter insights, and personalized outreach templates for students. Served as Integration Engineer on an 8-person team, connecting the React/TypeScript frontend to a Python FastAPI backend, integrating Firestore for dynamic real-time data loading, and building fallback logic to maintain app stability across the full stack.

projects.title: RANE — Mental Health Reflection App React, Node.js, MongoDB, Gemini API, ElevenLabs
projects.description: A women-centered mental health reflection app built at the InnovateHer Hackathon that uses the Gemini API to analyze free-form journal entries and translate emotions into intuitive "inner weather" states like fog, storms, and clear skies. Built the full-stack application using React, Node.js, and MongoDB, and integrated ElevenLabs AI voice synthesis for real-time audio coaching output. Designed with ethical AI constraints to avoid medical or diagnostic claims.

projects.title: Bay Area Waste Management — AI + IoT System Python, AI, IoT Sensors
projects.description: Designed an AI and IoT sensor system to optimize waste management infrastructure in the Bay Area as part of the Norman Mineta Bay Area Summer Academy. The project addressed real-world environmental and transportation equity challenges and earned a Bronze Award from the Metropolitan Transportation Commission.

projects.title: Emotional Analysis AI Model
projects.description: A machine learning model that classifies emotion from audio clips using MFCC feature extraction, spectral analysis, and cross-validation techniques, achieving 98% accuracy on a labeled musical dataset. Documented the full methodology and findings in a published technical article on Medium.
